notes.title: Galactic Chef Alpha 082: A few new challenges, bugfixes
notes.notes:
This is a relatively minor update:

 • Cmokemvfl Contest has been replaced with a three-part "Chef's Gauntlet".
 • The Galactic Chef pilot episode is back (Cmokemvfl is one of the challenges.)
 • Fixed a bug that would prevent loading a career if your last autosave occurred during a losing cutscene for a challenge you previously won.
 • Various other bugfixes.

notes.title: Galactic Chef Bugfix Update 0.71
notes.notes: This is just a quick fix for a few bugs. More bugfixes are likely coming soon.

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.61: Clearer text update
notes.notes:
This is a minor update:

* Increased text clarity
* Plates on the main menu no-longer spin

notes.title: Bugfix Update - Galactic Chef 0.51
notes.notes: Big updates mean lots of opportunities for bugs to slip through. This fixes a few critical issues, and more patches are likely to come soon as playtest feedback starts coming in.

notes.title: Major Galactic Chef Update! Version 0.50
notes.notes:
This is a major update with changes to UI, tools, ingredient generation, scoring and more.

Interface and Tools

* DataPad replaces the Notebook, with a new navigation system and detailed information on cooking techniques
* Hazard scanner replaces the laserboard magnifier, making it easier to locate and remove poisonous pits
* Gravi-Tongs can now pull nearby objects closer for easier grabbing
* Added Food Vacuum for easier disposal of unwanted scraps
* Knobs and tastelizer can now be dragged with any tool
* Removed "Pointer" tool and bandbox selection
* Tool hotkeys now correspond to their name rather than position on the toolbar
* Pipette can now discard liquids in the sink
* Improved look and behavior of in-kitchen buttons and tooltips

Simulation and Scoring

* Revised ingredient generation
* Judge preferences now have less impact on score
* More realistic boiling
* More realistic liquid merging
* Removed "gas" and "gritty" textures
* Added "stringy" and "rubbery" textures

Miscellaneous

* Five new ingredient templates
* Reduced repetitive cutscenes so the important ones are more noticeable
* Various bugfixes, tweaks, and polish

Known issues

 * Saved games from older versions will not load correctly but may still be playable
 * Ingredient simulation is still incomplete and will be updated soon

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.45: Another bugfixing and polish update
notes.notes:
- Grav hammer splatters now look more natural
 - Bandbox-selecting small pieces of food now works better
 - Added "a Note from the Dev" to the main menu
 - Minor bugfixes and tweaks

notes.title: Galactic Chef Hotfix Update 0.44
notes.notes:
This update fixes some game-breaking bugs:

 - Fixed: Missing lock icon on Globulator before unlocking it
 - Fixed: Sometimes liquids would be judged as another texture
 - Fixed: Laserboard didn't cut foods at all if they were partially outside the cutting area
 - Fixed: Crash when announcing the results of the final challenge
 - Added option to reset profile

Known issues (not new in this build):
 - Loading saves from older versions may crash
 - Liquid and gas simulation is still incomplete, and will be improved soon

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.41 - Soundtrack Update!
notes.notes: This build adds a first draft of the soundtrack, with 9 pieces of original music. There are no gameplay changes in this build, but any feedback on the soundtrack and/or bug reports would be appreciated!

notes.title: Galactic Chef Tutorial Update with Big Changes! (v0.40)
notes.notes:
What's new in Version 0.40?

This is a major update focused mainly on a new tutorial experience and polishing gameplay systems. Judging criteria have changed! Expect bugs, but please report them.

 - New introduction and tutorial experience
 - Judge preferences and major scoring changes
 - New notebook features including filtering ingredients by flavor
 - Creative mode
 - Numerous bugfixes and smaller improvements

Known issues:
 - Sometimes mousing over a texture icon does not show the texture name
 - There is still no music, but that is the next priority after bug fixing!
 - Liquid and gas simulation is incomplete, and will be improved soon.

notes.title: Minor Update v0.35
notes.notes: This fixes a missing background image for the unlocks screen, but also removes the feedback form. Online privacy laws are complicated, and I want to make sure I'm fully compliant if I'm going to collect feedback or any other data. The form may or may not be added back in the future, but feedback is always appreciated through other channels including the Steam Community Hub.

notes.title: Minor Update v0.34
notes.notes:
This is just a quick update to address a few things:

 - Added Feedback form
 - Changed heat reaction icons to be more colorblind friendly
 - Removed "Blue" challenge because it's unfair to colorblind players
 - Minor bugfixes

More and bigger updates will be coming in the next few weeks!
